rules.title: How it works
rules.digits: Every row and column holds each digit from 1 to {{k}} exactly once.
rules.blacks_one: Every row and column has exactly one black cell.
rules.blacks_other: Every row and column has exactly {{count}} black cells.
rules.sums: The numbers along the edge are the sums of the groups of digits between the black cells, in order.
rules.score: Your score is your time. The clock stops when you pause or put the game away.
